semanticDecisions: the stock shape finds the rightmost match first, as the stock loops do: the needle's last unit is sought backwards from the highest start the from-index allows and every candidate is verified backwards; the first candidate that verifies is the answer

the hand-off to the reverse KMP continues below the failed candidate with nothing matched: every match whose last unit lies above it was already ruled out, and the KMP's answer for the rest is the rightmost match there, so the word is the stock one on either path

the hand-off fires after eight candidates once the units verified reach the units walked, the sign of a text whose candidates verify long and often (a single-unit text against a needle ending in that unit); random text never fires it; when the plan is unavailable (a needle over the plan bound, or memory pressure) the stock shape runs to the end, as the stock loops would

the source is read raw, as the stock loops read it, the seek loop tight per coder (seekBackwards): the arguments fix every index inside the source (the highest start is at most the source length less the needle length; a verify never reads below the candidate's start)
a needle with a unit above 0xff is absent from a Latin-1 source at once (latin1), as the stock lane answers by coder; the KMP lane scanned the whole source for it
the needle's units come out once in bulk (A13), as before; LONG_NEEDLE stays 16, so shorter needles keep the compact-value lane of A21
